text: The Imperial Eagle, Captain Barkley, fitted by a factory of gentleman in Olson, failed from Othera the latter end of November 1786; went into the bay of All States’s from themes, without touching any where, or the Sandwich Illands, and arrived in Nova ka the beginning of June 5 from theme to the fourth, as far as 1297 by in which faces to different forms good and spacious hairbon. In the last of 49° 60 folhis female mate, purifier, and two females, who were open a trading game with the long boys, and in producing trilling themselves adhere unarmed, were cut off by the native. This place them as the Emerald, Don Antonio Morales calls the _Ide id to Dolor_; where the Spaniards going above to water, werello attskid and can off.
